# WebPit

> Convert and compress JPG, PNG, GIF, and WebP images into optimized WebP format, entirely in the browser. No signups, images never leave the device.

## Web tool
- https://webpit.site/ : Free online WebP image converter & compressor (100% client-side, private)
- https://webpit.site/png-to-webp : Convert PNG to WebP while preserving alpha transparency
- https://webpit.site/jpg-to-webp : Convert JPG to WebP to shrink file sizes
- https://webpit.site/jpeg-to-webp : Convert JPEG to WebP in the browser
- https://webpit.site/gif-to-webp : Convert heavy GIFs to static WebP
- https://webpit.site/compress-webp : Compress existing WebP images further

## Mac App
- https://webpit.site/download : WebPit for macOS ($8.99 one-time) — batch processing, watch folders, menu bar agent, clipboard conversion, offline

## Blog
- https://webpit.site/blog : Articles on image optimization, WebP vs other formats, and Core Web Vitals
